description: This file contains utility functions for managing session transcript files, including reading recent session content, handling reset fallbacks, stripping reset suffixes, and finding previous session files within a session directory.

methods.name: getRecentSessionContent
methods.description: Reads a session file and extracts the most recent messages, filtering out certain roles and content starting with '/'.

methods.name: getRecentSessionContentWithResetFallback
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve recent session content, falling back to reset files if necessary.

methods.name: stripResetSuffix
methods.description: Removes the '.reset.' suffix from a filename if present.

methods.name: findPreviousSessionFile
methods.description: Finds the previous session file based on session directory, current session file, or session ID.
